name: Madeira
about: The levada trails stay good almost any month, with no real off-season.
overview: A volcanic Atlantic island with a mild, subtropical 'eternal spring' climate year-round — levada (irrigation-channel) hiking trails, dramatic cliffs, and Funchal's record-breaking New Year's Eve fireworks.
costOverview: Madeira is one of the better values in Europe — a full espetada with a local beer costs just over ten euros, and even the famous wicker toboggan ride down from Monte stays reasonable.

specialSeasons.text: The Madeira Flower Festival fills Funchal with elaborate floral parades and displays.
Funchal's New Year's Eve fireworks are a record-holding, genuinely massive display over the harbor.
